jira.title: Jira connections
jira.description: Connect the Jira sites your teams work in. Credentials are tested before they are saved, then encrypted.
jira.emptyHint: Connect a Jira Cloud site or a Data Center server to start.

jira.patHint: In Jira: Profile → Personal Access Tokens → Create token.
jira.readOnlyNotice: Only workspace owners and admins can change connections.
